rules: Every node id in the shared metadata envelope is namespace-qualified: '<namespace>:<id>'.
Ids are unique within a namespace; the normalizer fails loudly on duplicates.
Cross-format references are resolved by the referencing node's source family, documented per namespace below; unresolved references are recorded in the integrity section, never dropped silently.
Prefixes are allocated by the owner of the namespace's source format, recorded here; new prefixes require a registry update in the same pull request.

namespaces.referenceResolution: Referenced by markdown ADR front-matter and OPA __rego__metadoc__ related_requirements fields.
namespaces.notes: The pipeline's own MoSCoW requirements; allocated in the moscow.md table by the requirements owner.

namespaces.referenceResolution: SpecTree specs reference each other: .ai requirementLinks and .test requirementCoverage resolve here; .ns adr fields resolve to the adr namespace; .ai adrReferences resolve to the adr namespace.
namespaces.notes: The SpecTree specification suite is a separate ID family from moscow: the .srs sample deliberately reuses M-/S- style prefixes. Namespace qualification (spec:M-001 vs moscow:M-001) is what makes the coexistence unambiguous; component ids are the .ai component names, test-suite ids are '<Component>.tests', nfr ids are the .ns entry ids.

namespaces.referenceResolution: Referenced by OPA metadoc related_adr, .ai adrReferences, .ns adr fields and ADR supersedes chains; markdown front-matter related_requirements resolve to moscow, spec-ADR related_requirements are preserved as evidence only.
namespaces.notes: A single decision has one node even if it exists as both a markdown ADR and an AdrSpec .adr file; the normalizer merges the sources.

namespaces.referenceResolution: Policies reference moscow requirements (related_requirements) and adr decisions (related_adr).
namespaces.notes: OPA gate policies. The .NET architecture policy family (APP-ARCH-/APP-SEC-) is a future extension point documented in the metadata contract page. SPEC- is the SpecTree validation gate (ADR-0020).
